related_questions.question: What is the Michigan First Credit Union money Now?

text_blocks.snippet: Michigan First Credit Union offers two overdraft protection services: MoneyNow and Overdraft Transfer Service. MoneyNow is a service that pays overdrafts up to a limit for checks, preauthorized payments, ACH drafts, recurring debit transactions, ATM transactions, and everyday debit card transactions. The Overdraft Transfer Service automatically transfers funds from a linked savings account to cover overdrafts.

list.title: How it works:
list.snippet: MoneyNow acts as a backup, covering overdrafts on your checking account up to a pre-approved limit.

list.title: Covered transactions:
list.snippet: This includes checks, preauthorized payments, ACH drafts, recurring debit transactions, ATM transactions, and everyday debit card transactions.

list.title: Fees:
list.snippet: While MoneyNow can help avoid declined transactions, it's important to be aware of potential fees if you use it. Overdraft fees can apply, so it's crucial to manage your account and replenish funds to avoid them.

list.title: Alternatives:
list.snippet: If you prefer not to use MoneyNow, you can also link a savings account to your checking account for overdraft protection. This way, funds can be automatically transferred from your savings to cover overdrafts.

list.title: Purpose:
list.snippet: Michigan First Credit Union also offers a MinuteMoney Emergency Loan, which is designed to provide quick access to funds for unexpected expenses like car repairs, medical bills, or appliance repairs.

list.title: Key features:
list.snippet: This loan can be accessed online with funds deposited directly into your account within 60 seconds, and it doesn't require a credit check.

list.title: Availability:
list.snippet: The MinuteMoney loan is a separate service from MoneyNow and can be a helpful resource when you need funds quickly.
